item.title: ‘We’ve seen this before’: Bird flu again hits Wisconsin poultry farms
item.description: Two large-scale commercial poultry farms in southeastern Wisconsin have been hit with avian flu, each with roughly 1.5 million birds that will be culled. The post ‘We’ve seen this before’: Bird flu again hits Wisconsin poultry farms appeared first on WPR.

item.title: UW-Oshkosh debuts women’s flag football as sport grows across Wisconsin
item.description: UW-Oshkosh is one of at least 10 Wisconsin colleges that have added or announced plans to add women’s flag football, according to Collegiate Flag Football, an online publication tracking the sport's growth. The post UW-Oshkosh debuts women’s flag football as sport grows across Wisconsin appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin lawmakers debate crypto ‘staking’ as bankers warn of fraud, consumer risks
item.description: In the ever-changing cryptocurrency industry, states are scrambling to understand the risks and rewards. One example is playing out right now in Wisconsin over a practice known as "staking." The post Wisconsin lawmakers debate crypto ‘staking’ as bankers warn of fraud, consumer risks appeared first on WPR.

item.title: This Wisconsin school district could soon start randomly drug testing students
item.description: The School District of Waukesha could soon be the next district in Wisconsin to start randomly testing students for drugs. The post This Wisconsin school district could soon start randomly drug testing students appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin family navigates loss of gender-affirming care at UW Health
item.description: In January, UW Health and Children’s Wisconsin halted gender-affirming care for minors following a federal executive order. A Dane County family describes the impact on their family. The post Wisconsin family navigates loss of gender-affirming care at UW Health appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Conservative Wisconsin Supreme Court Justice Annette Ziegler to retire
item.description: Justice Annette Ziegler, a conservative who has sat on the Wisconsin Supreme Court since 2007 and served four years as chief justice, will not seek reelection to the court next year. The post Conservative Wisconsin Supreme Court Justice Annette Ziegler to retire appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Data shows outdoor recreation boosts Wisconsin’s economy by record $12B
item.description: Outdoor enthusiasts provided a record-breaking $12 billion boost to Wisconsin’s economy, marking the state’s third record year in a row for outdoor recreation. The post Data shows outdoor recreation boosts Wisconsin’s economy by record $12B appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Interim leader named as UW-Madison provost
item.description: John Zumbrunnen has been named the University of Wisconsin–Madison's provost and executive vice chancellor for academic affairs, Chancellor Jennifer Mnookin announced Monday. The post Interim leader named as UW-Madison provost appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wausau company to pay $250K for alleged violations of Wisconsin air pollution laws
item.description: A Wausau company must pay $250,000 for nearly two dozen alleged violations of the state’s air pollution control laws under a settlement announced Monday by Wisconsin Attorney General Josh Kaul. The post Wausau company to pay $250K for alleged violations of Wisconsin air pollution laws appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Data: One-third of Wisconsin kids didn’t receive recommended shots by age 2
item.description: The state Department of Health Services found 66.9 percent of children age 24 months had completed their childhood vaccine series last year. The post Data: One-third of Wisconsin kids didn’t receive recommended shots by age 2 appeared first on WPR.
